data.current_summary: Link a Media Library asset to a dataset
data.current_description:
Creates a linked Media Library asset in your dataset. To support features like preview,
Media Library assets need to be linked to a local asset document.
Pair with the [Mutation API](https://www.sanity.io/docs/http-reference/mutation) to attach linked Media Library assets to documents.
Requires a token for a Sanity user. Robot tokens are rejected.
data.description_suggestion: Create a linked Media Library asset in your dataset by linking an external Media Library asset to a local asset document. This enables preview and other Media Library features. Requires a Sanity user token (robot tokens are not accepted). Accepts 2 parameters specifying the Media Library asset reference. Returns a linked asset document that can be attached to content documents via the Mutation API. Use the returned `document._id` to reference the linked asset in image or file fields.
